deploy.startCommand:
python -u -c "import os, traceback
print('CALENDAR_NOTICES_20261004_BEGIN', flush=True)
try:
    from app.simple_calendar import add_lines, rows_all, calendar, setup_editor
    from starlette.requests import Request
    from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
    setup_editor()
    targets = [('2026-10-09', 'School gesloten'), ('2026-10-12', 'School sluit om 12u20')]
    before = rows_all()
    for day, title in targets:
        exists = any(row['date'] == day and row['title'].strip().casefold() == title.casefold() for row in before)
        if not exists:
            add_lines(date=day, lines=title, structured='1', category='waarschuwing', lines_html='')
    after = rows_all()
    lookup = {row['id']: row for row in after}
    assert all(lookup.get(row['id']) == row for row in before), 'An existing calendar entry changed'
    for day, title in targets:
        matches = [row for row in after if row['date'] == day and row['title'].strip().casefold() == title.casefold()]
        assert matches, 'Notice missing: ' + day
        print('CALENDAR_NOTICE_SAVED', day, title, 'count=' + str(len(matches)), flush=True)
    document = calendar(Request({'type': 'http', 'headers': []})).body.decode('utf-8')
    soup = BeautifulSoup(document, 'html.parser')
    for day, title in targets:
        day_nodes = soup.find_all(attrs={'data-calendar-date': day})
        assert any(title in node.get_text(' ', strip=True) for node in day_nodes), 'Notice not rendered: ' + day
        print('CALENDAR_NOTICE_RENDERED', day, title, flush=True)
    print('CALENDAR_NOTICES_20261004_SUCCESS existing_entries_preserved=' + str(len(before)), flush=True)
except Exception:
    traceback.print_exc()
os.execvp('uvicorn', ['uvicorn', 'app.simple_calendar:app', '--host', '0.0.0.0', '--port', os.environ.get('PORT', '8000')])
"
